content.text: Imagine selling digital products in Nigeria but being blocked by Stripe. This isn't a small problem - for thousands of creators, it means sacrificing up to 10% of every sale to expensive workarounds. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) solves this by giving you a complete sovereign commerce infrastructure: Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, Supabase for order storage, NOWPayments for on-chain crypto payment verification, and Google Drive for file delivery. In this post, we'll dive into how Google Apps Script automates digital commerce and what it means for your business.
What This Actually Is and Why It Matters

Google Apps Script is a free server-side scripting platform that allows you to automate tasks on your Google Drive and Google Sheets. In the context of digital commerce, it's used to create a custom order fulfillment pipeline that automatically triggers when a crypto payment confirms on-chain. This means that once a customer makes a payment, you can programmatically deliver their digital product without any manual intervention. The result is a seamless experience for customers and a huge reduction in administrative overhead for creators.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The Edge Commerce Stack uses Cloudflare Workers, a lightweight serverless platform, to handle backend logic and integrate with NOWPayments for on-chain crypto payment verification. When a payment confirms, a webhook is triggered that fires an Apps Script function, which in turn updates a Google Sheet with order information. This information is then used to automatically deliver the digital product from Google Drive to the customer. The entire process is end-to-end tested and configured for SPF/DKIM/DMARC security best practices.
Who This Is Built For and Why

The Edge Commerce Stack and Google Apps Script automation are specifically designed for digital creators who sell digital products in countries with restricted payment infrastructure, such as Nigeria, Ghana, or Pakistan. These creators often face high fees, long payment processing times, and manual order fulfillment headaches. By using the Edge Commerce Stack and Google Apps Script, they can create a fully autonomous commerce infrastructure that allows them to focus on creating value for their customers.

The Components That Make It Work Together

Cloudflare Workers is the backend engine in Stack 02 deployments. It runs serverless JavaScript at the edge — code that executes in response to HTTP requests, including the incoming NOWPayments webhook. The free tier provides 100,000 requests per day, which is sufficient for the sales volume of most individual digital product sellers. Workers has no server to manage, no runtime to configure, and no infrastructure to maintain. It scales automatically. It is globally distributed — the same code runs in data centers close to wherever the request originates, which means your webhook endpoint responds quickly regardless of where NOWPayments sends the request from. Cloudflare Workers integrates natively with Cloudflare R2 for file storage and Cloudflare D1 or external Supabase for database operations.

How does automated digital product delivery work with crypto payments?

Automated digital delivery works through a specific technical sequence that eliminates every manual step. NOWPayments monitors the blockchain for incoming transactions to your configured wallet address. When a transaction receives the configured number of on-chain confirmations — typically one confirmation on Tron, which takes under 60 seconds — NOWPayments sends an HTTP POST request to the webhook endpoint URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings. Your Cloudflare Worker or Google Apps Script Web App receives this request, validates the webhook signature against the secret key you configured, reads the payment amount and transaction hash from the payload, confirms the transaction independently on the blockchain, logs the order to your database, generates a receipt, creates a time-limited download link for the product file, and sends the delivery email. The entire sequence completes in under 30 seconds from payment confirmation in almost all cases. Nothing in this sequence requires your presence, your attention, or any manual action.
